title: FancyZones exclude by pressing shift during drag no longer working

judgment.rationale: Current main already contains a direct fix for the first Shift-triggered FancyZones update path, and git history ties that change to PR #49985.
evidence: The report says Shift is pressed after the drag has already started.
WindowMouseSnap.cpp now switches snapping mode before highlight calculation so the first Shift-triggered update is not lost.
git log -L on WindowMouseSnap.cpp traces that change to PR #49985.
judgment.recommended_action: Point the reporter to the existing fix instead of starting duplicate design work.

fix_assessment.rationale: An existing upstream fix already targets the reporter’s exact first-Shift-during-drag failure mode.

issue_context.summary: The open issue matches a FancyZones bug already fixed on main: the first Shift press during an active drag could be discarded before zone highlighting updated.
known_information: The problem happens only when Shift is pressed mid-drag.
The reporter says it worked in the previous build.
Current main contains a comment in WindowMouseSnap.cpp describing exactly this lost first Shift-triggered update.
inferences: The issue likely targets a released build that predates the main-branch fix.
A maintainer follow-up should reference the existing fix rather than reopen design work.
issue_context.analysis: This is handled work, not a fresh design candidate. The live source and file history are specific enough to publish it as already covered by existing code.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the issue body and FancyZones behavior description.
Used git log -L to trace the first-Shift-triggered update fix to PR #49985.

actions.label: Explain upcoming FancyZones fix
actions.note: References the existing fix instead of starting duplicate design work.

comment.body: Thanks for the precise repro. Current main already contains a FancyZones fix for the first Shift-triggered update during an active drag, tracked in PR #49985. The change moves snapping-mode activation earlier so the first Shift press is not discarded. A maintainer follow-up should point to that existing fix and ask the reporter to verify it in the next build that includes PR #49985.

confidence.rationale: Source and history match the exact failure mode.
